eulerSwapV2ProtocolFeeConfig.assessment: The deployed EulerSwap V2 release (tag eulerswap-2.0) is newer than the code Cantina audited in September 2025, and protocol fees were redesigned since then. In the audited code each pool fixed its fee settings when installed, within 10–25%, and anyone could turn the fee on after one year. In the deployed code every pool reads its fee from one settings contract, EulerSwapProtocolFeeConfig, on each swap. Its admin can set a default fee and per-pool overrides that apply immediately, up to 15% of the LP fee (below the audited 25% maximum); zero is allowed. The admin may not be a known EVC sub-account, a non-zero default fee needs a non-zero default recipient, and every change emits an event. Per-pool overrides are checked only against the 15% limit, and an override without a recipient pays the default recipient. A pool's own LP fee recipient may not be a known EVC sub-account; this is checked when the pool is activated. The pricing curve and quotes are unchanged.

eulerSwapV2Implementation.assessment: Besides the protocol fee redesign, the code was split to stay under the contract size limit: management functions moved into a separate contract, EulerSwapManagement, which EulerSwap calls by delegatecall and whose address is fixed in the EulerSwap implementation. That contract is checked in this report from the same commit, and its address is confirmed in the implementation's code. The changes also handle vaults that can mint zero shares (as EulerEarn vaults can), and add hardening that landed at the eulerswap-2.0 release, such as keeping a pool locked while it is activated.

balanceTracker.assessment: One code change since the audited version: PR #26, which makes enableReward and disableReward return a boolean, makes updateReward and claimReward return the amount claimed, and adds an isRewardEnabled view. These change return values only, not how rewards are accounted. This commit, the merge of PR #27, also moves the EVC dependency to v1.0.0; a deployment built with the EVC at another commit compiles that version instead.

evc.assessment: This commit includes PRs #178 and #179: signature checks reject the EIP-7587 precompile addresses and the 0x42 predeploy addresses as signers. It is a five-line change that only rejects more cases, added before the November 2024 multichain deployment.

oracleRouterFactory.assessment: Every deployed commit makes the same change to the factory: it passes the EVC address to each router it creates (+10/−1). This mirrors the router side of the fix for Cantina finding 443, which the yAudit fixes review approved. The router code compiled into each factory has not changed since August 2024, apart from import paths.
